root_cause.text: The `icmp_glue_bits` function in `net/ipv4/icmp.c` fails to validate that the ICMP reply type is within the bounds of the `icmp_pointers` array before using it as an index, leading to an out-of-bounds read when processing extended echo replies.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of a bounds check `icmp_param->data.icmph.type <= NR_ICMP_TYPES` and the use of `array_index_nospec` before accessing `icmp_pointers[icmp_param->data.icmph.type].error` in `icmp_glue_bits()`.

bic_trace_step.reason: In the function `icmp_glue_bits` (lines 347-361), the code accesses `icmp_pointers[icmp_param->data.icmph.type].error` on line 358. The index `icmp_param->data.icmph.type` is a 1-byte field (`__u8`) that can take values up to 255, but the `icmp_pointers` array is defined with size `NR_ICMP_TYPES + 1` (line 222), which is typically 19. There is no bounds check on `icmp_param->data.icmph.type` before this array access, leading to an out-of-bounds read.
